title: Personal Loans Refinance-Purpose Payoff Quote: Calculation of the Good-Through Date and Payoff Amount
content:
## Which quotes are calculated this way

A refinance-purpose payoff quote of Personal Loans is calculated as set out here for a loan whose interest paid-through date is fewer than two whole calendar months (whole calendar months being the difference in calendar months, less one when the later date's day of the month is smaller than the earlier date's) before the quote date, whose AutoPay record shows at most one enrollment and at most one cancellation dated fewer than two whole calendar months before the quote date, and which has at most one payment of type additional principal posted fewer than one whole calendar month before the quote date. A refinance-purpose quote on any other loan, one with a longer or busier recent record, is issued as an ordinary payoff quote: good through the quote date plus the grade's payoff quote validity days in calendar days, with simple interest on the unpaid principal at the current interest rate from the interest paid-through date through its good-through date, actual/365, rounded to the cent, plus the unpaid fees on the quote date.

## The calculation

The quoted principal is the unpaid principal on the quote date. The quote window is the grade's payoff quote validity days, and the good-through date is the quote date plus the quote window. The quoted interest is simple interest on the quoted principal at the current interest rate, actual/365, for the interest days, which are the days from the interest paid-through date to the quote date (quote date minus paid-through date) plus the quote window, rounded to the cent. The payoff amount is the quoted principal plus the quoted interest plus the unpaid fees on the quote date.

The quoted interest is worked out once, on the total interest days, and rounded to the cent only at that point; the payoff amount is then rounded to the cent.

## Worked figure (hypothetical loan, 10-day validity)

| Item | Figure |
|---|---|
| quoted principal | 12000.00 |
| current interest rate | 11.00 percent |
| interest paid through / quote date | 5 April / 15 April |
| quote window / good-through date | 10 days / 25 April |
| interest days: 10 to the quote date plus the 10-day window | 20 |
| quoted interest: 12000.00 times 11.00 divided by 100 and by 365, times 20 | 72.33 |
| unpaid fees on the quote date | 15.00 |
| payoff amount | 12087.33 |

## Scope checks (hypothetical records, quote on 15 April)

| Record | Calculated as above |
|---|---|
| paid through 16 February: 1 whole month | yes |
| paid through 15 February: 2 whole months | no: ordinary payoff quote |
| two AutoPay enrollments dated in March | no: ordinary payoff quote |
| one additional-principal payment on 20 March | yes |
